Management takeover under section 15 has statutory publication and governance effects. Restoration after full realisation has the stated controlling-equity conversion exception. Section 16 bars the specified loss-of-office compensation but preserves other recoverable money claims. Do not turn one compensation exclusion into extinction of every amount owed to a displaced director or manager.

items.title: Record the decision, forum and event before calculating a period
items.core_explanation_md:
The section 17 application concerns the identified measures and is open to an aggrieved person including the borrower, with the stated forty-five-day period from the measure. The statutory jurisdiction alternatives and DRT powers matter; the Tribunal can examine compliance and order the stated restoration or other relief. Tenancy or lease claims require the section 17(4A) grounds and evidence, not an automatic conclusion from the word tenant.

An appeal under section 18 is different: its stated thirty days run from receipt of the DRT order. The borrower deposit uses fifty per cent of the lower of the creditor claim and DRT-determined debt; reduction for recorded reasons cannot go below twenty-five per cent of that base. A possible reduction is not an order already granted.

self_check.prompt_text: Should forty-five days from a measure be substituted for thirty days from receipt of the DRT order?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. They belong to distinct proceedings and triggering events.

items.title: Possession creates a custody responsibility
items.core_explanation_md:
Taking possession is followed by an evidence and preservation task. The source describes inventory, prudent care and protection, and insurance where necessary. A wasting asset can require the specified special treatment; do not assume every asset may be held indefinitely without a condition record. Preserve custody, condition, access and expenditure evidence.

For immovable property, the possession notice, service, affixing and prescribed publication are separate steps. Valuation precedes the reserve-price decision, with the required consultation. Possession is not the same as sale completion or automatic ownership. Electronic service in the retained amendment is additional to the prescribed modes; it should not silently replace every required service/publication step.

self_check.expected_takeaway: No. Read the actual service requirements and additional-mode provision.

items.title: Separate first sale, repeat sale and the payment stages
items.core_explanation_md:
The retained2016 amendment distinguishes the first immovable-property sale thirty-day rule from the not-less-than-fifteen-day subsequent-sale notice after a failed sale. The applicable service, affixing and publication requirements remain part of the process. Do not reuse a single unqualified period for every sale or confuse a possession notice with a sale notice.

The purchaser deposit is twenty-five per cent of the sale price, inclusive of earnest money already deposited, payable immediately on the same day or not later than the next working day as stated. The balance-payment rule and the permitted written extension must be checked separately; the amendment caps the described extension at three months. A private arrangement cannot be assumed to waive every statutory condition.

items.title: Reconcile realisations before allocating the residue
items.core_explanation_md:
The retained section 13(7) describes the treatment of money received after the relevant measure: absent a contrary contract, it is held in trust and applied first to properly incurred costs, charges and expenses, then to secured-creditor dues, with the residue paid to the person entitled under their rights and interests. The legal qualification and competing claims must be checked before applying this as a live distribution instruction.

For a stipulated exercise, show gross proceeds, qualifying costs, the amount available for debt, the amount applied and the remaining residue or shortfall. Do not count the same cost twice or call a surplus additional bank interest. The arithmetic does not settle a disputed cost entitlement or insolvency priority.

self_check.expected_takeaway: No. Identify the person entitled under the applicable rights.

items.core_explanation_md:
The described section 28 route can require a third party holding or owing the debtor money to pay the Recovery Officer. The notice does not make every rupee at that institution the debtor property. The applicable exemptions, joint-holder notices and rebuttable share presumption matter. A person genuinely not holding or owing the stated amount has the described sworn-objection route.

Payment in compliance with the notice receives the stated receipt and discharge to that extent. False objections and noncompliance have their own consequences, but they should not be assumed without applying the conditions. Section29 borrows specified tax-recovery procedures with necessary modifications; this does not turn the underlying bank debt into a newly assessed income tax.

self_check.expected_takeaway: No. Apply the share evidence, presumption and safeguards.

items.title: Transfer the legal record, not just the case label
items.core_explanation_md:
The statutory transfer provision concerns proceedings that satisfy its conditions at Tribunal establishment, with the stated exceptions; it is not a command to move every pending appeal. The records and stage already reached remain important. The separate route for an existing unexecuted decree seeks a recovery certificate on that decree rather than assuming that all original liability questions must be retried.

The framework also identifies the protected institutional officers, their public-function status, good-faith protection and rulemaking powers. Overriding and additional-remedy clauses need to be read together with applicable insolvency law. The source contradictory case-overruling summary is preserved for review rather than taught as a settled current priority rule.

items.title: Classify the claim before selecting the process
items.core_explanation_md:
Financial distress is a condition; admission to a statutory process is a legal event. The IBC framework seeks a collective resolution where appropriate, rather than guaranteeing the first creditor full payment. Financial debt concerns the stated time-value-of-money concept and inclusions. Operational debt concerns the described goods, services, employment and statutory dues. Assignment to a bank does not automatically change an operational claim into a financial one.

The IP administers the process, an information utility supports authenticated financial information, the adjudicating authority makes the required orders, and IBBI regulates the identified ecosystem. Entity coverage and actual commencement of individual/guarantor provisions must be checked separately.

items.core_explanation_md:
For the described financial-creditor route, the application must supply the applicable default evidence and proposed professional information. items.title: A process pause and a withdrawal need different authority
items.core_explanation_md:
A CIRP moratorium is a statutory protection linked to its order and scope; it is not a general statement that all guarantees or every third-party asset are extinguished. The 2026 amendment expressly addresses the described surety recourse against the corporate debtor. Historic section 10A relief also depends on the date the relevant default arose, not simply when someone later applies.

The amended withdrawal route uses the RP application with ninety-per-cent CoC voting approval, and bars withdrawal before CoC constitution or after the first invitation for resolution plans. A creditor agreement alone is not the complete withdrawal order. IRP/RP appointment and continuation likewise require the applicable route and records; an extension or replacement proposal is not already granted.

self_check.expected_takeaway: No. Apply the operative application, voting, timing and order requirements.

items.title: Eligibility, claim amount and decision threshold are separate
items.core_explanation_md:
Construct the CoC from the applicable eligible financial-creditor claims, with related-party exclusions and the stated regulated-creditor conversion exception checked carefully. A person can hold financial and operational claims; the character and voting treatment of each part must be separated. Representation by an authorised person does not multiply the underlying voting share.

The source ordinary decision threshold differs from specific decisions such as the sixty-six-per-cent RP appointment/replacement vote. Use eligible financial-debt voting share rather than lender headcount. The 2026 amendment also extends CoC supervision to the specified liquidation situations; it does not make every creditor an eligible voter.

items.title: A security election changes the distribution analysis
items.core_explanation_md:
A secured creditor liquidation file must distinguish relinquishing security to the estate from separately realising it under the applicable route. Surplus, shortfall, costs and distribution are not the same amount. The 2026 section 53 clarification limits the relinquishing creditor secured treatment to the determined security value where that value is below the debt; the remainder is treated as unsecured. Do not teach that relinquishment guarantees full-debt priority.

The waterfall also separates insolvency/liquidation costs, the specified workmen/secured-creditor tier, employee dues, financial unsecured debts and later categories. Excluded provident/pension/gratuity funds are not simply another distributable tier. Fast-track resolution, MSME pre-pack and solvent voluntary liquidation are distinct routes with their own conditions.

self_check.prompt_text: Does relinquishing security necessarily give the whole debt secured-tier treatment?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. Apply the amended valuation limitation and other distribution conditions.

items.title: Prepare the evidence package, not just a printout
items.core_explanation_md:
The1891 framework covers the described ordinary bank records, including electronic and backup records. A printout is not made a certified copy merely by adding a logo. Paper-copy certification addresses the true entry, ordinary business record and custody conditions; where the original was routinely destroyed, the further certification described in the source matters.

For electronic printouts, section 2A adds the computer-system and integrity certifications: authorised access, change detection, recovery, transfer and custody safeguards, plus the required statement about material operation and derivation. Identify the competent signatories and retained record. This unit is expressly about the 1891 syllabus framework; later replacement legislation and commencement need separate review.

items.title: An inspection order has scope, time and a response route
items.core_explanation_md:
The court can permit inspection and copying or require the bank to produce the specified certified entries. The further completeness certificate concerns other entries relevant to the matters in issue; staff must search the proper record scope before signing it. The source describes three clear days excluding bank holidays unless the authority directs otherwise.

Before the compliance time, the bank may use the stated offer-to-produce or show-cause route; an intention to object is not permission to silently ignore the process. Costs are in the court discretion, including the described bank fault or improper-delay circumstances, and the cost order has its own enforcement effect.

items.title: Referral opens a settlement opportunity; it does not prove agreement
items.core_explanation_md:
Ordinary Lok Adalat is a statutory conciliation forum organised by the described legal-services bodies. It can address suitable pending and pre-litigation disputes through the applicable referral process. Referral by a court or authority does not itself mean both parties have accepted settlement terms. The conciliators should assist agreement impartially rather than impose an independent merits decision when agreement fails.

If no compromise is reached, the pending case returns to its referring forum at the relevant stage; a pre-litigation party can pursue the proper ordinary remedy. Keep ordinary Lok Adalat separate from the distinct Permanent Lok Adalat regime. Non-compoundable offence matters are excluded; the textbook contradictory wording is not reused.

self_check.prompt_text: Does referral itself authorise an imposed ordinary Lok Adalat settlement?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. Referral and actual compromise are distinct.

items.title: Record the agreement that supports the award
items.core_explanation_md:
An ordinary Lok Adalat award rests on the actual compromise or settlement. The stated statutory effect treats it as a civil decree, final and binding on the parties, with no ordinary appeal under that framework. A draft offer or bank-only approval is not the same as an agreed award. Preserve the parties consent and the exact recorded terms.

The applicable court-fee refund is another consequence with its own conditions. Do not promise unrestricted reopening merely because a party later regrets the terms, or confuse absence of an ordinary appeal with a conclusion about every exceptional constitutional or fraud-related remedy. Those issues need independent legal review.

self_check.prompt_text: Is a bank-only approved offer already a binding settlement award?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. The actual compromise and award record must be established.

items.title: Evidence powers do not erase the forum type
items.core_explanation_md:
The framework gives the described Lok Adalat civil-court-like powers for attendance, documents, affidavits and relevant public records. Those tools support the statutory purpose; they do not convert ordinary conciliators into a general court deciding every failed negotiation. The composition and organising authority also need their proper legal basis.

The courseware monetary-ceiling statement is not treated as a universal limit for every form of Lok Adalat. Ordinary and Permanent Lok Adalats differ, and any bank settlement delegation, statutory jurisdiction cap or later notification requires the correct source and date. A convenient round amount is not a substitute for that classification.

items.title: Start with the person, transaction and alleged failure
items.core_explanation_md:
A consumer complaint needs the relevant complainant standing and transaction. Consideration can be paid, promised or deferred, and the definition includes the described approved users or beneficiaries. Banking is among the service categories, but commercial-purpose and other exclusions need the actual facts. The goods/self-employment explanation must not be treated as an unlimited exception for every commercial banking service.

Defect concerns the relevant goods or product standard; deficiency concerns the quality, nature or performance of a service, including the described negligence or withholding of relevant information. A written allegation, its denial and a proved breach are separate stages. Identify the contracted obligation, conduct and evidence instead of equating dissatisfaction with automatic liability.

self_check.prompt_text: Is every disappointed banking customer automatically a successful complainant?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. Standing, scope, obligation and the alleged deficiency need evidence.

items.title: Separate a harmful term from a misleading sales practice
items.core_explanation_md:
An unfair-contract concern focuses on the terms and their effect on the consumer, such as manifestly excessive security, a disproportionate penalty or an unjustified one-sided power. An unfair-trade-practice concern can arise from misleading claims, false bargains, unfulfilled promotional promises, the described receipt/refund failures or improper disclosure of confidential information. The same file may require more than one analysis.

Consumer rights include information, safety, hearing and redress; a signed standard form does not automatically prove every term is fair. Preserve what was promised, the actual terms, what was charged and the information supplied. Do not infer statutory approval or affiliation from an advertising claim alone.

self_check.prompt_text: Does a signed form by itself prove that all its terms are fair?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. The statutory unfair-term analysis remains separate.

items.title: The similar institution names describe different functions
items.core_explanation_md:
Consumer Protection Councils advise on promoting and protecting rights. CCPA has the described class-protection, investigation and enforcement functions. The District, State and National Commissions decide the complaints and appeals assigned to them. An advisory meeting is not a substitute for an adjudicatory order.

For ordinary complaint jurisdiction under the 2021 rules reproduced in the chapter, use consideration paid: District up to INR 50 lakh, State above INR 50 lakh up to INR 2 crore, National above INR 2 crore. Do not substitute compensation demanded, copy older original-Act figures, or apply these ordinary limits mechanically to the separate unfair-contract jurisdiction. Territorial grounds and later changes also need checking.

items.core_explanation_md:
A consumer file needs the exact order and proceeding before choosing an appeal route. Finality, enforcement as the described decree-like order, and satisfaction are distinct events. An unpaid final order does not become satisfied merely because the case status says disposed.

Mutual-account treatment also requires the actual reciprocal-demand facts; calling a ledger current account is not sufficient to establish every legal condition.

items.title: The filing date alone does not identify the governing tax law
items.core_explanation_md:
The textbook explains the 1961 Act using previous year and assessment year. The Income Tax Department transition FAQ identifies the 2025 Act from1April2026 and the Tax Year terminology for income of2026-27 onwards, while preserving the described earlier-period proceedings. Before using an old section number or form, record the income period, governing Act and applicable saving. Residence and source remain separate analytical questions; citizenship, account label and tax residence must not be treated as interchangeable. The textbook legacy rates and section references are research context, not an unqualified current filing guide.

items.title: Classify the amount before applying a tax rate
items.core_explanation_md:
The source computation separates income under the relevant heads, gross total income, permitted deductions and taxable income. Exempt income is not simply a deduction chosen after applying a rate, and a deduction is not automatically a rupee-for-rupee tax credit. The applicable regime and eligibility conditions determine what can be used.

Filing a return, processing it, scrutiny and reassessment are also distinct events. An acknowledgement is not proof that every computation was substantively accepted. The textbook deadlines and revision limits are not used as current universal rules; a working file needs the governing year, Act and current instrument for each date.

self_check.prompt_text: Does a return acknowledgement prove all claimed deductions were finally allowed?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. Filing and substantive assessment are separate.

items.title: Withholding is a compliance chain
items.core_explanation_md:
For a covered payment, identify its character, recipient status, applicable law, trigger and rate. Deduction, depositing tax, reporting the transaction and issuing the required certificate are separate tasks. A deduction in the bank ledger is not evidence that Government remittance and statement reconciliation occurred. PAN identifies the taxpayer; TAN concerns the deductor framework described in the source.

Non-resident and treaty treatment needs the relevant eligibility and documentary conditions rather than an automatic lowest-number rule. Likewise, a reporting or identification threshold is not necessarily a prohibition on receiving a larger deposit. The book contains dated and overbroad shorthand; current rates, deadlines and disallowance proportions must be checked before publication.

self_check.expected_takeaway: No. Deduction, deposit and reporting need separate evidence.

items.title: Read the transaction before choosing a commodity-tax rate
items.core_explanation_md:
CTT is a transaction tax under the described Finance Act framework. The source distinguishes derivative sales and option events, including exercise and delivery/settlement differences, with agricultural-commodity exclusions. A single rate and payer cannot safely be copied to every commodity event. Identify instrument, event, taxable base, liable side and applicable dated provision.

The recognised exchange collection/remittance role is another obligation; failure to collect is not automatically cancellation of the statutory remittance liability. Do not confuse CTT with income tax on trading profit or with GST on a separate service fee. Current rates need primary verification and are not represented by the old table as a live calculator.

self_check.expected_takeaway: No. The transaction, event, base and liable party differ.

items.title: A cross-border payment is not a complete GST analysis
items.core_explanation_md:
GST concerns the taxable supply and its applicable classification, valuation and place-of-supply rules. The source distinguishes the intra-State dual structure from the inter-State IGST structure. Input tax credit reduces eligible output liability subject to the actual statutory conditions; possession of any invoice is not an unlimited credit entitlement.

An import-of-services analysis needs the provider location, recipient location and place of supply, plus the relevant consideration or specified related/distinct-person rules. Paying in foreign currency alone does not establish every element. Exercises below stipulate a rate and eligible credit to teach arithmetic, not to certify a current banking-service tax treatment.

self_check.expected_takeaway: No. The location, place-of-supply and applicable scope conditions matter.

items.title: A business conversation has several legal stages
items.core_explanation_md:
An invitation to discuss terms is different from a definite proposal. Acceptance must match the proposal in the required way; a response changing a material term is not automatically unconditional acceptance. The accepted promise and reciprocal consideration support an agreement, but enforceability also requires the legal essentials.

Oral arrangements can have legal effect, while particular transactions require writing, registration or other formalities. A signed page does not cure an unlawful object, and an unsigned discussion is not automatically a concluded bank facility. Identify the communication, terms, intention and transaction-specific formalities before deciding what has been formed.

self_check.prompt_text: Does a reply changing a material term necessarily accept the original offer?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. Matching acceptance and a changed proposal must be distinguished.

items.title: The remedy depends on the defect and the transaction
items.core_explanation_md:
Free consent requires more than a signature. Coercion, undue influence, fraud, misrepresentation and the relevant mistake rules can have different legal effects. Void and voidable should not be used interchangeably:the latter involves the stated party option and applicable relief, not automatic enforceability for everyone.

Bank-customer roles also depend on the transaction. An ordinary deposit creates a debtor-creditor relationship with the bank as debtor; an advance reverses the basic debt positions. Collection work can involve agency, and delivered safe-custody goods can involve bailment. Do not classify every bank service as a trust or decide locker liability from an old shorthand label alone.

self_check.expected_takeaway: No. Identify the particular service and its legal incidents.

items.title: An indemnity claim starts with the covered risk
items.core_explanation_md:
The indemnifier promises to protect the indemnity holder against the covered loss. Identify whose conduct and which risk the promise addresses before adding amounts to a claim. Section125 distinguishes damages, costs and compromise payments with the relevant prudence, authority and scope conditions. An invoice marked legal expense is not automatically recoverable in full.

The undertaking and its limits also distinguish indemnity from a guarantee of another person default. Do not assume all insurance contracts are indemnities or that every indemnity defeats all statutory restrictions. For banking uses such as a duplicate-instrument undertaking, preserve the actual language, claim facts and applicable conditions.

Do not assume the creditor must always exhaust every remedy against the principal debtor before proceeding against a liable surety. items.title: Separate accrued liability from future transactions
items.core_explanation_md:
A continuing guarantee extends to the described series of transactions. Revocation by notice ordinarily concerns future transactions; it does not automatically erase covered exposure already incurred. Death has the stated future-transaction effect absent contrary contract. The actual notice, knowledge, accounting and undertaking need careful reconciliation.

An unconsented variance and a contractual release of the principal debtor differ from mere forbearance to sue. Releasing one co-surety also has distinct consequences for other sureties and their contribution rights. Do not collapse every collection delay, renewal, settlement or death into the same complete-discharge result. Identify the event, consent, scope and timing before deciding what liability remains.

items.title: Mutual agency distinguishes the relationship

A lender, employee or former owner may receive an amount linked to profits without becoming a partner. Ask whether the business is conducted by all, or by someone acting for all. Do not infer a partner status merely from the payment formula. An ordinary firm also differs from an incorporated body: the legal consequences of partner agency and liability require separate examination.

items.title: Start with the agreement, then use the statutory default
items.core_explanation_md:
In the absence of a contrary contract, the described defaults include equal sharing of profits and losses and no automatic remuneration for participating in the business. Interest on capital, where payable under the stated rule, is payable out of profits. A qualifying advance beyond agreed capital is treated differently: the source specifies six per cent per annum. items.title: Consultation is neither automatic disclosure nor a veto

The statutory exemptions cover different protected interests, including the described security, commercial, fiduciary, investigation and personal-information categories. items.title: Electronic form is only one part of legal validity
items.core_explanation_md:
The IT Act supplies the described recognition of electronic records and signatures and supports electronic contracting and government services. A record is not invalid solely because it is electronic, but that does not prove capacity, consent, authority or every other contract requirement. Distinguish the originator, the intended addressee and an intermediary carrying or storing the message.

Retention requires the described accessibility, accurate representation and origin/destination/time details, subject to the statutory qualification for automatically generated transmission information. A screenshot may preserve appearance while losing relevant metadata or the reliable original record. Design the evidence trail so the record can be retrieved and its integrity assessed later; a file existing somewhere is not enough.

self_check.prompt_text: Does electronic recognition itself prove the sender had authority?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. Form, authority and the other validity requirements differ.

items.title: Signing and verification use different keys
items.core_explanation_md:
In the described asymmetric system, the private key creates the digital signature and the corresponding public key verifies it. Verification addresses the signature relationship and whether the signed record has changed. It is not a general guarantee that every commercial statement in the document is true or that the signer had unlimited authority.

The Controller supervises certifying authorities and the relevant standards. A licensed certifying authority issues certificates under the statutory framework; the subscriber has the corresponding duties. Check the certificate and its status, the signature, the record integrity and the signer authority as separate parts of the file. An image of a handwritten signature is not automatically the same as this digital-signature process.

self_check.prompt_text: Does a valid digital signature prove every underlying factual assertion is accurate?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. It does not replace substantive transaction verification.

items.title: Access permission and the particular act both matter
items.core_explanation_md:
The source identifies unauthorised access, copying, extraction, disruption, damage and other specified computer acts within the section 43 compensation framework. Permission to perform one task is not necessarily permission to extract all data or alter another account. Distinguish a contravention remedy from the separate offence and mental-element requirements; do not classify every incident through a single penalty label.

The described appeal from the Controller/adjudicating-officer order goes to TDSAT within45 days from receipt of the copy, with the stated sufficient-cause extension and consent-order exception. Criminal investigation has its own authorised-officer rule. Preserve permissions, logs, record versions and order-receipt evidence rather than relying only on an allegation that the system was hacked.

self_check.prompt_text: Does permission for a routine task automatically permit copying every database?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. The scope of permission and the particular act matter.

items.title: Technical importance and statutory protected status differ
items.core_explanation_md:
Critical information infrastructure is the described computer-resource category whose loss or destruction would have the specified debilitating national-security, economic, public-health or safety impact. Protected-system status involves the appropriate Government notification and authorised access framework. A manager calling a system critical does not replace that legal designation.

The national nodal-agency provision concerns critical-infrastructure protection. CERT-In and other statutory roles must be distinguished through their own provisions. The Act also has a specific electronic/truncated-cheque application route linked to the Negotiable Instruments Act definitions and Government notification in consultation with RBI. Do not infer that every scanned document is a legally equivalent cheque.

self_check.prompt_text: Does an internal critical label itself prove protected-system notification?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. Check the statutory designation and access authority.

items.title: Read the exceptions to the exclusions
items.core_explanation_md:
The First Schedule excludes specified documents/transactions, but the 2022 amendment changes the negotiable-instrument and power-of-attorney entries and omits the immovable-property contract/conveyance entry. The described qualifying demand-promissory-note/bill route depends on the specified regulated-entity relationship; it is not every negotiable instrument. The power-of-attorney exception likewise depends on the specified regulated entity and scope. Trusts and wills remain distinct excluded categories in the source.

Removing an IT Act exclusion does not itself waive registration, stamping, attestation or other execution rules. Also distinguish DPDP staggered commencement: the RTI amendment and the IT Act amendments do not all share one start date. Pin the legal version before assessing a document intended for a particular exam session.

self_check.prompt_text: Does removal from an IT Act exclusion automatically remove registration requirements?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. Other applicable formalities remain separate.

items.title: An improper benefit need not be cash
items.core_explanation_md:
The Prevention of Corruption Act uses defined public-duty and public-servant categories extending beyond a simple payroll label. The described categories include qualifying public bodies and persons performing the specified public functions. Government appointment is not the sole test. Establish the actual role and statutory category before concluding coverage.

Undue advantage concerns gratification other than legal remuneration and is not confined to money or a benefit that can readily be priced. A favour, service or other non-cash benefit cannot be dismissed solely because no cash changed hands. Equally, an authorised remuneration payment must be distinguished from an improper benefit. Analyse the benefit, purpose, recipient and duty rather than relying on a gift label.

self_check.prompt_text: Can a non-cash benefit fall within undue advantage?
self_check.expected_takeaway: Yes. The definition is not restricted to monetary gratification.

items.title: Classify the alleged conduct before choosing an offence
items.core_explanation_md:
The source distinguishes receiving an undue advantage, influence-related conduct, giving/promising it, commercial-organisation exposure, responsible-officer conduct and abetment. The offence elements and applicable exceptions must be established for the particular actor. A company payment does not automatically prove every director personally committed the same offence.

The amended criminal-misconduct definition includes the described dishonest/fraudulent misuse of entrusted property and intentional illicit enrichment. Disproportionate resources and the lawful-source explanation require the statutory evidentiary analysis. Ordinary loss-making lending is not automatically proof of dishonest conversion. Repeat-offence and attempt provisions also have defined conditions; do not extend a provision addressing one clause to every attempted act.

self_check.prompt_text: Does every bad commercial outcome automatically establish criminal misconduct?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. The applicable statutory conduct and evidence must be established.

items.title: A punishment range belongs to a particular offence
items.core_explanation_md:
The source gives different imprisonment ranges and fine consequences for different offences. For example, the described section 7 and abetment routes use three-to-seven-year ranges, while criminal misconduct has its own four-to-ten-year range. Do not use a single maximum for all conduct or confuse an attempt with the completed offence. Fine determination considers the described obtained-property/value or unexplained-resource factors under the applicable provision.

Special Judges try the specified offences. The source describes a two-year trial endeavour, reasoned extensions in six-month periods and an ordinary aggregate four-year formulation. This is not a promise that every case automatically terminates at an absolute stopwatch deadline. The special forum and lawful transfer/appellate rules must be distinguished; the fact a forum is special does not mean no transfer can ever occur.

self_check.prompt_text: Is the described trial-duration formulation an automatic acquittal rule?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. Do not replace its qualified language with an absolute outcome.

items.title: Rank, prior approval and sanction answer different questions
items.core_explanation_md:
Section17 specifies authorised investigator ranks and qualifications: the source distinguishes DSPE, the stated metropolitan category and other areas, with the specified State-authorisation route and additional illicit-enrichment investigation requirement. Establish the actual jurisdiction and authorisation rather than applying one rank everywhere.

Section17A concerns prior approval for the described inquiry/investigation into offences relatable to an official recommendation or decision. The appropriate approval authority depends on the employment/removal relationship. The on-the-spot arrest for accepting or attempting to accept undue advantage has the stated exception. The decision period is three months with the described reasoned one-month extension. The2021 SOP concerns processing; do not call it a fresh statutory amendment.

items.title: Verify the power and preserve the relevant record
items.core_explanation_md:
The section 18 inspection route concerns the described investigation/inquiry necessity and the suspected person accounts or accounts of someone suspected of holding money for them. The bank supplies the relevant certified entries as required. The power has the stated Superintendent-of-Police rank or special-authorisation qualification; it is not unrestricted access for every person who presents a police identity card.

Section19 prosecution sanction concerns court cognizance for the specified offences and its own authority/procedure, including the described former-office cases. It differs from section 17A prior-investigation approval. The source preserves failure-of-justice qualifications concerning sanction defects rather than automatic invalidity for every irregularity. High Court appeal/revision powers also require the applicable procedural framework. Preserve authority, scope, certification and disclosure logs.

self_check.prompt_text: Are section 17A approval and section 19 prosecution sanction interchangeable?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. They govern different stages and conditions.
